comment: Add tested Vega-Lite semantics, diagnostics, filtered tooltips, recursive views, managed resources, and ranged rendering. Add onRenderCalloutPerDataPoint to GroupedVerticalBarChart, HeatMapChart and PolarChart, onRenderCalloutPerStack to GroupedVerticalBarChart, and identity-preserving onRenderCalloutPerPoint to ScatterChart. Preserve legacy Scatter all-values-at-x callbacks and null-to-default fallback; new point callbacks hide surfaces on null and use native defaults on undefined. Preserve native routing for ordinary and default-typed grouped bars, validate tooltip number format defaults during preflight, preserve raw tooltip fallback in legacy mode, stabilize diagnostics delivery, and use deterministic sampling with bounded full-size data preparation.
